subject.title: feat(agents)!: remove the stored default agent — sole agent or explicit ownership

question: Do maintainers approve retiring the stored default-agent marker for existing multi-agent installations once the current head demonstrates the full upgrade-and-restart transition with real runtime evidence?
rationale: This is a repository-wide compatibility contract spanning persisted configuration, agent auth inheritance, sessions, cron ownership, channels, and Gateway clients; test coverage cannot alone establish the upgrade behavior on the changed head.

options.title: Require isolated runtime upgrade proof
options.body: Keep the migration design and request a redacted real CLI/runtime transcript that proves migration, restart persistence, preserved owned routing, and the explicit ownerless error.

options.title: Accept test-only proof
options.body: Land based on the transition suites and CI while explicitly accepting residual upgrade risk across deployed multi-agent fleets.

recommendation.title: Require isolated runtime upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Keep the migration design and request a redacted real CLI/runtime transcript that proves migration, restart persistence, preserved owned routing, and the explicit ownerless error.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history and linked merged ownership work identify steipete as the strongest available owner for the migration contract.
